description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single-target Water/NE physical attacks (0.9 each), grants [Attach Water with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Lion v2)], and [Water Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Lion v2)
description.text: Water abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water abilities trigger 2 additional times, Deadly strikes 5/10/15/20% for equipped Water abilities after using 1/2/3/4+ Water abilities.

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] & [Dual Awoken Water Mode II (Lion v2)] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Lion v2)]
